description: The only rate limiting rule of Cloudflare Free (§6): 300 requests per 10 s per IP and data center. Free accepts only the Path and Verified Bot fields. Webhooks, verified bots and immutable build assets do not count, so a shared mobile IP (CGNAT) is not blocked by page assets. Finer limits live in the app (Valkey).

rules.description: Whole site: 300 requests per 10 s per IP
rules.expression: not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/api/webhooks/") and not starts_with(http.request.uri.path, "/_next/static/") and not cf.client.bot
